setup: apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends build-essential pkg-config libssl-dev ca-certificates curl
sudo -u homemade env RUSTUP_DIST_SERVER=https://static.rust-lang.org mise install rust@1.99.1
warmup: if [ ! -f web-vault/vw-version.json ]; then archive=$(mktemp) && curl -fL --retry 2 --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 120 https://github.com/dani-garcia/bw_web_builds/releases/download/v2026.10.1/bw_web_v2026.10.1.tar.gz -o "$archive" && tar -xzf "$archive" && rm -f "$archive"; fi
install: if [ ! -f web-vault/vw-version.json ]; then archive=$(mktemp) && curl -fL --retry 2 --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 120 https://github.com/dani-garcia/bw_web_builds/releases/download/v2026.10.1/bw_web_v2026.10.1.tar.gz -o "$archive" && tar -xzf "$archive" && rm -f "$archive"; fi
